issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() should return a double, but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int (performing integer division). This mismatch between the specified return type and the solution implementation can confuse students and cause tests that expect a double to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() return a double and compute the value using floating-point division (e.g., (double)getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors()). Update the solution implementation accordingly so it matches the UML and expected behavior.
